## Equations
### EQC-MEASUREMENT — Polarization measurement state

*Defines the transmitted polarization projector used in every Born probability.*

$$
|\theta\rangle=\sin\theta|H\rangle+\cos\theta|V\rangle,\quad \Pi_\theta=|\theta\rangle\langle\theta|
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (7), TeX label measurement directions as Kets

Numerical form:

```
q(theta) = [sin(theta), cos(theta)] in the [H,V] basis; projector = outer(q, q.conj()).
```

Code: `scripts/verify_formulas.py`, `src/wigner_model.py::measurement_ket`


### EQC-SOURCE-STATE — Fitted two-photon source state

*Defines the pure component of the fitted source model.*

$$
|\Psi(w,\xi)\rangle=\sqrt w|HV\rangle+e^{i\xi}\sqrt{1-w}|VH\rangle
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (18), TeX label eq:sagnacstate

Numerical form:

```
psi = [0, sqrt(w), exp(1j*xi)*sqrt(1-w), 0] in the [HH,HV,VH,VV] basis.
```

Code: `scripts/verify_formulas.py`, `src/wigner_model.py::source_state`


### EQC-DENSITY — Isotropic-noise density matrix

*Defines the fitted mixed state whose probabilities form every generated model curve.*

$$
\rho(w,v,\xi)=v|\Psi\rangle\langle\Psi|+\frac{1-v}{4}I_4
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC-SOURCE-STATE` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (20), TeX label eq:modelstate

Numerical form:

```
rho = v*outer(psi, psi.conj()) + (1-v)*eye(4)/4.
```

Code: `scripts/verify_formulas.py`, `src/wigner_model.py::density_matrix`


### EQC-BORN — Density-matrix Born probability

*Evaluates each of the three plus-plus probabilities for the fitted mixed state.*

$$
P_{++}(\alpha,\beta)=\mathrm{Tr}\!\left[\rho\left(\Pi_\alpha\otimes\Pi_\beta\right)\right]
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC-MEASUREMENT`, `EQC-DENSITY` · source: paper_equation: Eqs. (8)-(9) and Born-rule text

Numerical form:

```
p = real(vdot(kron(q_alpha,q_beta), rho @ kron(q_alpha,q_beta))).
```

Code: `scripts/verify_formulas.py`, `src/wigner_model.py::born_probability`


### EQC-WIGNER — Wigner value

*Combines the three generated probability curves into the main plotted observable.*

$$
\mathcal W=P_{++}^{\hat a\hat b'}+P_{++}^{\hat b\hat c'}-P_{++}^{\hat a\hat c'}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC-BORN` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (5), TeX label Wigner_value

Numerical form:

```
W = p_ab + p_bc - p_ac, evaluated pointwise on the common angle grid.
```

Code: `scripts/verify_formulas.py`, `src/wigner_model.py::wigner_components`


### EQC-SINGLET-LIMIT — Singlet analytic Wigner limits

*Provides model-independent analytic checks for symmetric and asymmetric target geometries.*

$$
\mathcal W=\frac12\left(\sin^2\Delta_{ab'}+\sin^2\Delta_{bc'}-\sin^2\Delta_{ac'}\right)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC-BORN`, `EQC-WIGNER` · source: paper_equation: Eqs. (9)-(13)

Numerical form:

```
symmetric_limit = -0.125; asymmetric_limit = (1-sqrt(3))/4.
```

Code: `scripts/verify_formulas.py`, `src/wigner_model.py::ideal_violation_limit`


### EQC-FIDELITY — Fidelity to the singlet

*Checks the fitted state against the paper's reported singlet fidelities.*

$$
F_{\psi^-}=\langle\psi^-|\rho|\psi^-\rangle=v\left(\frac12+\sqrt{w(1-w)}\right)+\frac{1-v}{4}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC-SOURCE-STATE`, `EQC-DENSITY` · source: paper_equation: Eq. (21) and Sections V.A-V.C

Numerical form:

```
F = v*(0.5 + sqrt(w*(1-w))) + (1-v)/4.
```
